keyword.zh: 柴油120是不是两台发动机

title.en: How Diesel 120 Prints Two Engine Units
title.zh: 柴油120怎样印出两台发动机

description.en: Diesel 120 prints 290 kW as two units of 145 kW, and it prints two Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pumps. It does not say the units run one at a time.
description.zh: 柴油120把 290 kW 印成两台各 145 kW，并印两台川崎112液压泵。它没有说这两台可以轮流单开。

h1.en: How Diesel 120 Prints Two Engine Units
h1.zh: 柴油120怎样印出两台发动机

directAnswer.en: The Diesel 120 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints engine power as 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The hydraulic-pump cell prints Kawasaki 112 (two units). Theoretical output is a single 100 m³/h, not 100 per engine. Outlet pressure is 40 MPa and distance is 150 m / 500 m. The page does not print a procedure for running one unit alone, so this note does not invent one.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油120混凝土泵把发动机功率印成 290 kW（两台各 145 kW）。液压泵格印川崎112（两台）。理论输送量是单独的 100 m³/h，不是每台发动机 100。出口压力 40 MPa，距离 150 m / 500 m。页面没有印只开一台的步骤，因此本文也不编造。

body.en: It refers to the power cell and, separately, to the hydraulic-pump cell. Both say two units. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print the engine code 4105, 4108 or 6105 on this page. Aggregate is 6 cm and below. Weight is 8000 kg.
body.zh: 它分别指功率格和液压泵格。两边都写两台。河北品锦机械没有在这一页印 4105、4108 或 6105。骨料为 6 cm 及以下。重量为 8000 kg。

heading.en: Output is not doubled by the reader
heading.zh: 产量不要由读者再乘一次

body.en: The output cell already says 100 m³/h. It does not say 100 m³/h times two. Adding another 100 would invent a figure. The distance pair is likewise one pair, 150 m horizontal and 500 m vertical.
body.zh: 产量格已经写了 100 m³/h。它没有写 100 m³/h 乘以二。再加一个 100 就是编造。距离也是一组：水平 150 m，垂直 500 m。

body.en: Unlike LZ-80, Diesel 120 does not print high and low ceilings. It also does not say that one 145 kW unit is a listed operating mode. If that question matters, use /en/contact/ rather than a guessed half output.
body.zh: 和 LZ-80 不同，柴油120没有印高低两档上限。它也没有说一台 145 kW 是列出的运行模式。如果这个问题重要，请用 /zh/contact/，不要猜一个一半的产量。

question.en: How many kilowatts are printed in total?

answer.en: 290 kW, written as two units of 145 kW.

question.en: Is output 200 m³/h if there are two engines?
question.zh: 两台发动机是否意味着产量 200 m³/h？

answer.en: No. The printed theoretical output is 100 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。印出的理论输送量是 100 m³/h。

question.en: What hydraulic pump text is printed?
Does the page list a one-engine setting?
question.zh: 页面列出单发动机设定吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print that mode.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有印这种模式。
